newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Oct 96 trade gap $2.5 bln, up $183 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Oct 96 trade gap $2.5 bln, up $183 mln.

text.p: Hungary's accumulated trade deficit was $2.5 billion in the January-October period, $183 million more than in the first nine months of 1995, the Trade Ministry said on Thursday.
The trade deficit was an accumulated $2.3 billion in January-September 1996, according to previous ministry data.

January-to-October exports totalled $10.6 billion, up 184 million on the same period of 1995. January-to-October imports amounted to $13.1 billion, up $368 million on the same period of 1995, the industry and trade ministry figures showed.
